lastCompletedStory.title: Migrar os arquivos de instrucao executavel para o comando novo e regenerar o blob embutido

openQuestions: AC1's oracle only matches a typed-subcommand mention followed by a plain space or end-of-line; several backtick-terminated mentions in the same 17 files (e.g. `cam tag` in scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md:140, `cam claude` in .claude/commands/cam-next.md:33 and templates/commands/cam-next.md:33) were left untouched because they don't match the narrow oracle and are outside the planner's exact per-file counts (measured 2026-08-01). They are a known, accepted oracle gap, not a defect introduced by this story -- flagging in case a future doc-hygiene story wants to close the gap.

The scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md and templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md pair is NOT byte-mirrored (confirmed by diff): the templates/ copy is a generic-project starter template with placeholder stack sections, so it only needed the single 'cam patterns archive' -> 'gship patterns archive' rename, not the full set of renames applied to the real scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md.
nextStoryContext: The typed CLI invocation surface in executable instruction files (.claude/agents, .claude/commands, templates/agents, templates/commands, templates/scripts/cam/*.md|*.json, scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md) now says `gship <subcommand>` instead of `cam <subcommand>`, matching the binary rename ADR-0054 already applied to help/usage/--version output (US-002) and the packaged installer (US-004). Exactly the AC1 oracle's narrow match set (subcommand token followed by a literal space or end-of-line) was renamed via a per-file `perl -i -pe` substitution -- the four historical-prose files (scripts/cam/journal.md, journal.archive.md, patterns.md, patterns.archive.md) were deliberately left untouched (AC4 pin: rewriting history falsifies the record, ADR-0054 already forbids it), and the five internal-contract layers (CAM_*, .cam-*, tmux -L cam socket, /cam-* slash commands, scripts/cam/ path) were left untouched (AC5 pin: those rename in a later, still-unscheduled cycle per ADR-0054's bounded pre-launch window). `bun run embed-vendor` was re-run after the templates/ edits to regenerate src/vendor/_generated.ts (it embeds templates/ only, never .claude/), and two tests that asserted a literal 'cam issue list' / 'cam issue --file-local' substring against the embedded persona/command content were updated to the new 'gship ...' wording in the same commit. `bash scripts/build-release.sh --install` was re-run post-commit so ~/.local/bin/gateship and ~/.local/bin/gship exist and reflect this story's renamed instruction files before the live orchestrator loop (which is mid-cycle on this very branch) respawns and re-reads scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md / .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md; ~/.local/bin/cam was left untouched (still the pre-rename binary the loop is currently spawned from -- do not remove it, ADR-0055). This story (US-005, priority 5) is the last of CAM-460's PRD per the notes' own 'SEQUENCIA OPERACIONAL' comment, so the next agent invocation (if any) is likely the review/ship phase, not a new implementer story.
